SELECT N.CNC AS cnc, LTRIM(STR(N.SLength, 10, 2)) + 'x' + LTRIM(STR(N.SWidth, 10, 2)) + 'x' + LTRIM(STR(N.SThickness, 10, 2)) AS plateSize, N.MatRef AS material, N.Quantity AS quantity, ROUND(N.Quantity * N.SWeight, 6) AS totalWeight, CAST(ROUND(N.SProfit, 2) AS VARCHAR(32)) + '%' AS utilization, CAST(ROUND(N.SProfitS, 2) AS VARCHAR(32)) + '%' AS utilizationWithoutRemnant FROM dbo.DIS_NEST_NEST_00000100 N
AND N.JobRef = #{q.jobRef} AND N.CNC LIKE '%' + #{q.cnc} + '%' AND N.MatRef LIKE '%' + #{q.matRef} + '%'
ORDER BY N.CNC, N.JobRef

SELECT MIN(M3.IOrder) OVER (PARTITION BY P1.PrdRef) AS partSequence, P1.PrdRef AS productCode, P1.Image AS imagePath, M3.Quantity AS quantity, P1.DIS_UData3_Prt AS customerPartNo, M3.OrdRef AS batchNo, M3.DIS_MatRef AS material, M3.DIS_Thickness AS thickness, P1.DIS_UData1_Prt AS process FROM dbo.MMNN_MMOO_00000300 M3 LEFT JOIN dbo.PPRR_PPRR_00000100 P1 ON M3.PrdRef = P1.PrdRef
AND M3.DIS_JobRef = #{q.jobRef} AND P1.PrdRef LIKE '%' + #{q.prdRef} + '%' AND P1.DIS_UData3_Prt LIKE '%' + #{q.customerPartNo} + '%' AND M3.OrdRef LIKE '%' + #{q.ordRef} + '%' AND M3.DIS_MatRef LIKE '%' + #{q.matRef} + '%' AND P1.DIS_UData1_Prt LIKE '%' + #{q.process} + '%'
ORDER BY partSequence, M3.IOrder, M3.MnORef
